reasoning: The icon consists solely of the three block letters 'CSS' with no pictorial symbol or graphic container. While recognizable to web developers as Cascading Style Sheets (or to students as the CSS Profile), pure text labels violate the rule against icons that are only letters or digits and read poorly as a glanceable pictorial reminder.
